title: Settings
name: Name
profileNote: Shown in the phone preview. It stays in this browser.
photosNote: As you add a photo, Bands can use when it was taken and the city it was taken in to keep a shoot together. Lineup keeps the city, never the exact position, and neither leaves this browser. Photos already on the board have none, because Lineup does not keep originals. Turning a switch off does not remove what was already read.
safariNote: Safari can delete a site's data after seven days without a visit. Adding Lineup to your Home Screen or Dock protects your board. An installed app starts empty, so back up here and restore there.
backupNote: A backup is one file with your images and their order. Restoring replaces the board, and Undo brings the old one back.
backupFailed: The backup could not be made. Try again.
restored: Board restored. Undo brings back the one before.
restoreFailed: That file could not be restored. It may not be a Lineup backup, or it may be incomplete.
storageNote: Your images are kept in this browser and never leave it until you schedule a post.
